progression_tree.description: Bodyguards specialize in keeping clients alive—absorbing fire, interposing themselves in harm’s way, and controlling the battlefield to deny attacks.

When a creature you can see within 5 feet of you is targeted by an attack, you can use your reaction to become the target of that attack instead. If the attack hits you, reduce the damage by an amount equal to your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier.
While you are not incapacitated, allies within 10 feet gain +1 to AC and have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

When a creature within 5 feet of you makes an attack against a target other than you, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against that creature. On a hit, the target’s speed becomes 0 until the start of its next turn.

Once per short rest, you can grant temporary hit points to yourself and allies within 10 feet equal to twice your level. While any of these temporary hit points remain, you and those allies have resistance to blaster damage.

Enter an unbreakable guarding focus for 1 minute (once per long rest). During this time, you can use Interpose without expending your reaction once per round, and when you reduce damage with Interpose, the protected ally gains temporary hit points equal to your Constitution modifier.
